1.web: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
1.asv: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.

2.web: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
2.asv: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.

3.web: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
3.asv: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.

4.web: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
4.asv: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work isdonein faithfulness.

5.web: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
5.asv: He loveth righteousness and justice: The earth is full of the lovingkindness of Jehovah.

6.web: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made; all their army by the breath of his mouth.
6.asv: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

7.web: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
7.asv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.

8.web: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
8.asv: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

9.web: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
9.asv: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.

10.web: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
10.asv: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

11.web: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
11.asv: The counsel of Jehovah standeth fast for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.

12.web: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
12.asv: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

13.web: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
13.asv: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;

14.web: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
14.asv: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth Upon all the inhabitants of the earth,

15.web: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
15.asv: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their works.

16.web: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
16.asv: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

17.web: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
17.asv: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.

18.web: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness;
18.asv: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his lovingkindness;

19.web: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
19.asv: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

20.web: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
20.asv: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.

21.web: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
21.asv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.

22.web: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
22.asv: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee.
